data.one_liner: A widget that allows a single child to scroll in two dimensions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SingleChildTwoDimensionalScrollView widget inspired by SingleChildScrollView that enables scrolling in both vertical and horizontal axes simultaneously. It allows diagonal scrolling or axis locking using the diagonalDragBehavior parameter.
use_when: You need a single large child widget to scroll in both horizontal and vertical directions
You want a behavior similar to SingleChildScrollView but in two dimensions
avoid_when: You are displaying large lists or grids that benefit from lazy loading (use a two-dimensional grid or table instead)
You only need standard single-axis scrolling
strengths: Enables two-dimensional scrolling for a single child widget
Supports diagonal scrolling and axis locking options
Includes cache extent and scroll position restoration features
weaknesses: Relies on a single child, so it is not optimized for massive lazy-loaded data sets
Core two-dimensional functionality depends on underlying framework foundations
